verdict.rationale: Fivetran's own docs say transformations run automatically after connection syncs or on a set schedule. Connectors sync automatically, and the pricing page lists 1-minute syncs, which implies recurring sync cadences. The evidence does not document how users configure sync frequency or schedules, or how an AI-native user would schedule jobs programmatically via the REST API or MCP server, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable connector sync schedules/frequencies, documented API or MCP control of schedules, cron-style or workflow-level scheduling details, independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Transformations are automatically executed after connection syncs or on a set schedule.
Fivetran provides pre-built data connectors that automatically sync data from your applications, databases, event streams, and files to your data warehouse or data lake.
